scenarios.answer: The evidence shows the dependency runs one way: **`ekos-runtime` depends on `ekos-recovery`** (evidence 681ccf11-3148-475c-baee-9f6bb6b5e74f). There is no claim that `ekos-recovery` depends on `ekos-runtime` — the recovery crate's manifest lists only `ekos-common`, `ekos-kir`, `ekos-artifact`, and other dependencies, not `ekos-runtime` (evidence dd930470-7da2-5d10-91a8-de88c93069f9). Therefore, **`ekos-recovery` can exist without `ekos-runtime`**, while `ekos-runtime` cannot exist without `ekos-recovery`.
